subject.title: Agent confabulates completed actions on Telegram surface — same config works reliably on Claude Code/Codex

question: Should this remain entirely plugin/ClawHub scope under existing hooks, or should OpenClaw core add a narrow runId/outbound-delivery correlation seam for verifier plugins?
rationale: The user-visible failure is real enough to keep tracking, but broad claim verification is optional policy that VISION.md routes out of core unless a concrete plugin API gap blocks implementation.

options.title: Plugin Policy Plus Narrow Seam
options.body: Keep verifier behavior outside core, but accept a focused core API fix if plugin proof shows exact-turn outbound correlation is currently impossible.

options.title: Plugin Only
options.body: Treat the closed broad verifier discussion as final and ask affected deployments to publish or install a ClawHub verifier using current sessionKey-based correlation.

options.title: Core Verifier
options.body: Make OpenClaw own built-in success-claim verification despite the new policy, config, and upgrade-safety surface.

recommendation.title: Plugin Policy Plus Narrow Seam
recommendation.body: Keep verifier behavior outside core, but accept a focused core API fix if plugin proof shows exact-turn outbound correlation is currently impossible.

likelyOwner.reason: He made the closest recorded boundary decision on the broad verifier request and is the clearest owner signal for core policy versus plugin scope.
